overview.en: This fossorial rodent inhabits eastern European steppe and forest-steppe, with strong populations in eastern Ukraine extending east toward the Volga.
overview.fr: Ce rongeur fouisseur habite les steppes et steppes boisées d’Europe orientale; des populations importantes vivent dans l’est de l’Ukraine et vers la Volga.

identification.en: Its eyes are reduced and covered by skin; powerful incisors and a reduced tail are adaptations associated with underground life.
identification.fr: Ses yeux réduits sont couverts par la peau; ses incisives puissantes et sa queue réduite sont liées à la vie souterraine.

habitat.en: In eastern Ukraine it is associated with preserved steppe, meadow-steppe and open slopes of ravines.
habitat.fr: Dans l’est de l’Ukraine, il fréquente les steppes préservées, les prairies steppiques et les versants ouverts des ravins.

diet.en: It eats underground plant parts and may store roots and other food in burrow chambers.
diet.fr: Il consomme des parties souterraines de plantes et peut stocker des racines et d’autres aliments dans les chambres du terrier.

behavior.en: It excavates long, shallow feeding tunnels and deeper chambers; juveniles may appear above ground while dispersing.
behavior.fr: Il creuse de longs tunnels d’alimentation peu profonds et des chambres plus profondes; les jeunes peuvent sortir en surface lors de leur dispersion.

reproduction.en: A field study in the Velikoburlutskyi Steppe reported one annual litter of one to three pups.
reproduction.fr: Une étude de terrain dans la steppe de Velikoburlutskyi rapporte une portée annuelle de un à trois petits.

ecology.en: Its eastern Ukrainian distribution is uneven, and field studies associate it with remaining steppe patches; cultivation and fragmentation are reported pressures on steppe fauna.
ecology.fr: Sa répartition est irrégulière dans l’est de l’Ukraine; les études de terrain l’associent aux fragments de steppe encore présents, tandis que la mise en culture et la fragmentation affectent la faune steppique.

conservation.en: The Ukrainian museum species page assigns no conservation category; local habitat pressures should not be mistaken for a global assessment.
conservation.fr: La fiche du musée ukrainien ne lui attribue aucune catégorie de conservation; les pressions locales sur l’habitat ne constituent pas une évaluation mondiale.

title.en: Greater mole-rat species record — State Museum of Natural History, National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine
title.fr: Fiche du grand spalax — Musée national d’histoire naturelle d’Ukraine

facts: The Ukrainian museum describes reduced skin-covered eyes, digging incisors and a reduced tail, reports strong populations in eastern Ukraine toward the Volga, and gives no conservation status.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Current distribution and food storage of Spalax microphthalmus in eastern Ukraine
title.fr: Répartition actuelle et stockage alimentaire de Spalax microphthalmus dans l’est de l’Ukraine

facts: The Ukrainian-language study reports uneven eastern distribution, activity in steppe and meadow-steppe sites, and negative effects of cultivation and fragmentation on steppe fauna.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Biological characteristics, feeding and tunnel structure of the greater mole-rat
title.fr: Caractéristiques biologiques, alimentation et structure des tunnels du grand spalax

facts: The 2018 study reports underground plant feeding, tunnel and storage chambers, juvenile surface dispersal and one litter of one to three pups per year.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: The museum source does not assign a conservation category; no current global assessment was confirmed for this draft.
Annual litter size comes from one regional field study and may not describe every population.
review_note: Draft only. English and Ukrainian-language museum and field sources were cross-checked; reproductive values are explicitly tied to one regional study.
